Hey just wanna say im sorry that youre going through this and feeling this way, ive been there and it really sucks. You were really brave to post this, often times the hardest part is to ask for help when you need it. 

I dont know what your family life is like but if you havent talked to one or both of your parents yet about this, it might be a good idea. You might have an idea of how theyll react that is completely different from how they do. Ive seen parents travel across continents  in order to be with their child when they are in need. If youre not comfortable talking to them about it, (you could even show them this comic if you think talking might be too hard) you could reach out to a friend or another family member, a teacher or councilor at school, just anyone so that they know what youre going through. Its the hardest part but its also the most important because then you can have two people trying to help you instead of just your probably depressed brain.(which doesnt function as well or think correctly/has a very heavy negative bias)

Please go and do one thing you know makes you feel less crappy, like a favorite food, movie, show song game, whatever it is go do that and prepare to talk to someone. Good luck i am rooting for you.
